title: status always shows an 'Old Court Verses: 0/3 (unexplored: the ring-ditch, the king's causeway, the mere-stone)' tracker alongside the real 'Verses' tracker, but across ~290 turns of thorough play (talking to every NPC found, reading every board/ledger, visiting Last Light, Fenmarch/Reedholm in full, and all of Ashwood) no dialogue, quest, or notice ever mentioned it. It reads as a second, unexplained quest line cluttering the status screen.
